nom: Perricone MD Neuropeptide Eyelid Lift Serum

avis.titre: Neuropeptide Eyelid Lift is an Eye opener works great
avis.texte: This product is the best thing to use for the eye area I saw a big difference the first time I used it
I have been using Perricone products since they first came out & they just keep getting better. I love the Neuropeptide Eye Lift Serum It keeps the Crepe's away!

I bought this product around the holidays as an eye kit being offered at the time. This product came opened and all over the kit. Called customer service they would not send me a replacement bottle because it came in a kit and only offered to give me a $20 credit. I really like perricone md product but have been reluctant to purchase anything since.

avis.titre: Test best line eraser I've ever tried
avis.texte: This is unbelievable so good. Ive tried so many different kinds and this is the BEST.
It is ok I was accepting better result for such an expensive serum
So far I haven't seen any difference. I use it morning and night.

I'm not sure about this product yet. Its been about 4 weeks and no difference. To be fair, I feel I need to use it longer. What I don't like about it is that it leaves a dry flakey film around your eyes. I have to wipe my eyes a few times through out the day.

The texture of this product is very much serum'y, so it absorbs well. It remains sticky for a long time after applying, so it is challenging to wear under makeup if you're in a hurry. I did notice a marked difference though between the left (before) and right (after) eyes, but the results only last a couple hours, and I haven't tried reapplying over makeup. Not sure I'd buy this one with my own money, but I will continue to use the remaining product in the bottle.
What a difference this has made. Not only for the creepiness but I think it has helped my eyelashes also

avis.titre: Did not lift my upper eyelids
avis.texte: I have been using this serum twice a day for about three weeks, but it did not do anything. I don't see any improvement for my upper eyelid.

I love this eye serum and will repurchase and recommend to all of my friends! I'm in my mid thirties so this eye cream is a necessity! It really helps brighten and lift. I used it this morning and I've had a LONG day working 14 hours medsurg and I'm exhausted but I think my eyes don't look extremely tired! Thrilled with the results
Wow, Ive tried creams and this works beautiful! It well worth the cost

Very pleased with this Eyelid Lift serum. It's amazing how it works on those 'droop' eyelid days! Also, I am still very happy with all the products I have been using when I started a few years ago. C. Higuchi
Really works well. Reduced rough texture and tightens eyelid skin.

Smooth and creamy and with an easy to use dropper. It does not firm as expected, but does add a good amount of moisturizer around the eyes. My skin is sensitive and it dos not burn or cause irritation.

I was really excited to receive Perricone MD Neuropeptide Eyelid lift serum but it was much too strong for me it's recommended to use morning and night. I tried it for just under one week and started feeling itchy and stinging. I had to discontinue so don't know if it helps with firmness.

avis.titre: Amazing eye serum that lifts and plumps!
avis.texte: Perricone MD does it again! I'm legit obsessed with their eye products and feel like my purple, baggy, sleep deprived eyes seem much more plump and bright! If you're looking for something to bring more life into your eyes and give you a nice lift to make you look awake then look for further! Oh, and, a LITTLE GOES A LONG WAY Queens!

Nice packaging, I love how thin and clear the formula is. My only problem is that I personally have very sensitive eyes and using products specifically around them can cause a minor burn, and this did trigger that. Not sure it is one that I would purchase again but I do see a visual improvement after using.

This serum goes on smooth and I had no reaction to it. I like the texture and how it felt light on my skin however, I didn't see much of a change in my eyelids. Maybe I just need to use it a little longer. Also went on smooth under makeup, which was great!

avis.titre: This actually works and doesn't irritate my eyes
avis.texte: Perricone MD is my absolute favorite brand of all time because they use ingredients that work amazingly well with their very own recipe every time. I don't claim to be an expert on what is used to make an incredible product, but I know what works and this eyelid lift serum is magic! I have always had "sleepy eyes" and as I age, it's going from Bette Davis to plain old tired. One drop dabbed on both eyelids makes me look more awake and I can still put makeup on. I have the most sensitive eyes EVER, but I have had no adverse reactions. I normally won't put anything around my eyes because of how sensitive they are, but I trust this brand. I'm just so pleased!

avis.titre: Serum that actually does what it claims to do!
avis.texte: I'm hooked on this eyelid serum. It actually improves the texture of my skin. At 69, it's a tall order.

Overall, I didn't see many improvements but I think it may require more long term use. Thankfully, no negative reactions and doesn't sting. The texture is liquidy but not unruly. You also don't need a ton. There is a slight smell, so if you're sensitive to fragrance, I'd try to test it if you could.

avis.titre: Big price tag, but I liked the results
avis.texte: I really enjoyed this product, the packaging was glass and very heavy. And for how much you use, there was a lot of product in the bottle. The consistency was just right, not too thick or thin.it absorbed quickly into the skin. It felt a little tacky at first, but dried down quickly. I didn't see a huge difference in any fine lines, but my skin felt very soft and well moisturized. The price point is high, but a bottle feels like it would last a good while, and I liked how my skin looks and feels after using it

avis.titre: No issues and worked with eye makeup but not sure it lifted
avis.texte: I liked this eye serum and i had No issues with it but I'm not sure if it lifted or tightened. It did work well with eye makeup and my makeup didn't rub off onto where i put the serum so that was a happy surprise. It smoothly went on. I tried applying both a normal moisturizing eye cream on top and also an anti aging eye cream on top and had no sensitivity or reaction with either one. I wanted to see great results from this but I'm not sure it lifted. I can never really see a difference from any eye cream or product.

This eye serum works very well under my eye cream. It is very soothing and does not sting at all. My upper lids seem to be less crepey and I will continue to use this product. Looking forward to continued results. Only con is that it is very runny

I'm loving this Perricone MD eyelid lift serum. Im 54 and My eyes don't look as fresh as they used to when I was younger. A few drops on each eye, slightly rub in and watch the magic happen. Gives a gentle lift by using morning and night with no irritation and no smell.

Really liked this product. I do feel that it helped with the those fine lines/crows feet. Did not cause irritation and felt that with daily use, I saw the effects throughout the work day. Just 1-2 drops and applying it with ring finger did the trick. Because you use so little each day, the bottles lasts a while making it more affordable.

This serum is lightweight but my skin soaked it right up! I've been using just a dab under both eyes on on each eyelid daily for a few weeks and my skin is stronger, more hydrated, and I can see a difference in the lines under my eyes too.
This goes on comfortably and dries down. I only used it at night because I don't want it to cause eye shadow creasing. I didn't notice any lifting or tightening on my eye lids.

This serum is so great and light weight. I love the feel of it and it dos seem to help with under eye puffiness. It's super thin but feels silky and not at all watery which is nice. I definitely look forward to using this product.
I've never had an eyelid product and I love it! It feels so hydrating and I love the ritual of putting it on with my eye cream. It feels great on and is definitely something I'll keep using.

As I continue to age, I'm always looking for products to help me slow down Father Time. Perricone MD has had consistently effective products packed with potent ingredients, which I love and appreciate. I can honestly say I felt my eyelids lifting and my wrinkles and creases being targeted by this product. The dispenser was easy to use for me and my hand health too. As someone with arthritic hands with muscle and tendon issues, I appreciate the easy dispenser for this serum.
I've been using the eyelid lift serum for several years. The addition of neuropeptides has vastly improved the serum!

The Perricone MD Neuropeptide Eyelid Lift Serum makes the delicate skin around the eyes so nice and hydrated, with firming effects. The skin feels more elastic and my eyes look brighter and well rested. It didn't irritate my sensitive eyes and make them water. I appreciate the bottle having the dropper separate as well. I like having it as part of my nightly routine, highly recommended.

The formula is lightweight and smooth, absorbing quickly without leaving any greasy residue. The perfect texture to layer under skincare and makeup. It helps with making my eyes look more refreshed, firmed and more lifted.

This eyelid lift serum is a clear lightweight liquid dispensed with a dropper in the packaging .Very easy to just use a small bit on ring finger to pat onto eyelids. Product dries quickly and leaves lids smooth and even. Makeup looks so much better after using this serum. Great for mature skin and did not irritate my eyes.

Great product and definitely fits that niche need of needing something for eyelids, not just undereye serums (I have plenty of products for under eye, none like this one here!!). No irritation to sensitive skin and visible results! I received this product free courtesy of Influenster, however, I love this brand and am grateful to have such a targeted product to address specific needs. I already have, and certainly will continue recommending to others! Pricey, but worth it, especially if you can find it on sale!

I received this product for free from Influenster and Perricone MD in exchange for my honest review. I've been using this product consistently and I'm super impressed with how lightweight the formula feels. It has a very fluid texture that absorbs quickly. There is no stickiness or heavy residue either. After a few weeks of use, I noticed my eyelids looked smoother and less crepey. The fine creases appeared softened and my lids looked a bit more lifted and refreshed overall. It for sure gives me a more "awake" appearance, especially on the days when I'm feeling tired and drained. I love that it layers well under makeup without pulling too. This is definitely a higher-end product but the elegant texture and visible smoothness makes it feel worth the investment. I'd recommend this to anyone with sagging skin or texture changes around the eye who wants to look and feel like their younger self! Total confidence booster!

The texture is silky smooth and goes on the skin nicely. It gives a light tingle when you put it on and I do believe it is helping after using it for awhile. My eyes look a bit more refreshed. I will definitely continue to use this

avis.titre: Feels Nice But Lack of Results
avis.texte: A little serum goes a long way. It feels runny but one drop sits nicely on your finger and if you drop the bottle you don't lose all the product. Trust me, I tested it by accident. The serum has no scent, smooths on nicely and dries quickly without making your eyes feel dry. I wouldn't say it's a miracle worker and honestly I can't notice much of a difference from using it. I did a test with just one eye for this review, the right eye has the serum. In my opinion the other eye in my photo looks better. Not sure this is worth the money.

I used this product for 30 days twice a day as instructed. It was easy to apply and didn't irritate my skin or dry it out. It dries nicely and isn't sticky. I could put makeup on after it dried. There is no scent that I could smell. The bottle is small enough you could take it with you if you travel. I took before and after pictures and didn't see a difference. Maybe it needs to be used for a longer period of time but by the time I received the product and by the time this review was due, I only had the 4 weeks. You can see the before and after pictures and decide if it is worth the money.

avis.titre: A product that delivers the results it promises
avis.texte: A thin formula that packs a punch! Super easy to apply and safe to use morning and night. After just 4 weeks of using, I have seen significant improvement of my under eye!

I received the Perricone MD Neuropeptide Eyelid Lift Serum from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. It only too a half of a drop to go around my entire eyes. I didn't have any irritation or stinging at all. It's smoothing and moisturizing with no redness. Leaves my eyelids looking less puffy and more smooth.

This new eye serum I am reviewing is the best I've tried. The absorption is very quick. I really enjoy that I can layer makeup on top of the serum and there is no indication that the serum was used. No beading or uncomfortable feeling. I have not had any irritation or adverse reactions. I would highly recommend this serum to friends and family.

I have tried this eyelid lift serum 4 times and I have yet to see any results. I can feel the slight tightening sensation but I don't see a noticeable difference. It didn't cause any sensitivity or reaction. Since I have the serum I will continue to try it to see if it helps over time.

As a Perricone MD loyalist, I really wanted to love this. The application is seamless because of how quickly it absorbs into the skin without being greasy. That said, three weeks in, I'm not seeing the results justify the cost just yet. Given that my sagging is minimal, I thought this would be a holy grail fix, but it has stayed pretty stagnant. I'll finish the bottle, but I'm underwhelmed so far.

I have been using this product for a couple of months and I don't have anything negative to say about it. I can't say for sure if I've noticed a drastic difference with my eyelids, but someone with a few more years may see better results. I suspect it's good preventive care to keep that skin looking firmer and smoother. It doesn't have an offensive smell, it's a nice texture, and it doesn't feel like gross on your skin.

I really enjoyed the consistency of this product, and it definitely feels refreshing around the eye area when applied. I have some small, fine lines around my eyes but otherwise not too many concerns. I didn't notice a huge change in the appearance of my eyes, but I'll absolutely keep using this to see if maybe it just takes more time for less drastic concerns.

I have been using this product for a little over 3 weeks and the results are incredible! I was able to extend my Botox by another month!! This is a serum like consistency and I found you do not need a whole dropper full maybe about half. I pat it in with my finger tips, it's dries relatively quickly and absorbs into the fine lines and crepey skin giving you the appearance of a more lifted eyelid and smoother crowd feet. I actually use the excess on my marionette lines too!
This is something I've never tried before. An eyelid serum. I was pleasantly surprised. It's light and absorbs well, non irritating and my eyelids feel smoother. My makeup applies nicely over it too.
The formula is very lightweight and absorbs quickly under my eyes. I like the dropper application. I do wish the formula was a little thicker but I think I will love this when it's warmer out.

This serum feels great on my skin and I love the application dropper! I used for 4 weeks and didn't see much of a difference. I will continue to use but not sure I'll rebuy since no difference. No scent which I love!

I love how the texture is lightweight on my skin. It feels gentle. I also appreciate how the eye cream does not melt up into my eyes like some serums can do. It leaves a soft finish that doesn't feel sticky. I do that the skin under my eyes feel more comfortable. Blends like a dream as well.

Ok, I have terrible double vision. It is bad. They were talking about doing an eyelid surgery to help, but this product helps firm my eyelids some that it makes me vision so much better. Easy to Use. No smell. I love this stuff.

The consistency of this is so thick and jelly like almost, it reminds me almost of snail mucin but its really cooling. I dont feel like it was oil at all, but this is like liquid gold, a tiny bit goes a long way. You should only use a tiny bit initially anyway. Im looking into preventative skin care and I feel like the peptides in this are perfect. I typically have puffiness around thr eyes and some days its more apparent than others, this helped with that too. I love perricone products!

I have been using this eye serum consistently for the last few weeks and I am definitely noticing a difference. The area around my eyes look less tired/puffy. A little goes a long way so this serum will last me a long time! Very impressed!

This Neuropeptide Eyelid Lift Serum feels gentle but effective. It does not cause any irritation, blends in well, absorbs into my delicate skin and helps my eyes look more awake. It has a smooth, serum texture that really helps it cover my eye area without difficulty. I very much enjoy this product.

Unfortunately this product did not do what it claimed to do. My eyelids look the same, not even tighter. I hold highly priced products to a high standard cause money is important, this product disappointed me. Although it does feel great on my eyes!
Not quite sure it did anything. It might've made a small difference. The good news is it didn't irritate my sensitive skin. The consistency was thin.

I really liked this product. I like the smell and the feel. I like the thickness, not too thick and dries quickly. The dropper is nice and the amber bottle is attractive. It somehow manages to lift your eyelids slightly. It doesn't burn or tingle your sensitive around the eyes thin delicate skin.

This is a fantastic instant action lifting serum. It's a watery gel like finish and a little goes a long way! I have not seen long term effects from the use of this serum so I've started only using it in the mornings. It helps smooth crows feet and noticeably lifts my heavy eyelids. If you're looking for an instant lift to eyelids and smoothing of fine lines this is a fantastic option!

This water weight eye serum absorbs quickly. It is unscented and doesn't irritate my eyes. The skin around my eyes looks smoother when I use this. I'm going to continue to use it and look forward to to seeing some lift in my upper eye area.

I have been really enjoying this eye serum. Its a thin and watery consistency that absorbs nicely so I can wear it under my makeup. I do love the tightening feeling it gives my undereyes. It makes my eyes feel awake and refreshed when I apply it in the morning. I've only been using it for a few weeks but I would definitely recommend it. It also doesn't have a scent so it hasn't been irritating for me. Its a little pricey which is why i deducted a star and the packaging could he nicer for that price. Just saying.
A small amount goes a long way! Love the consistency of this product not too heavy on the skin. No Residue left behind it drys now nicely. Worked to reduce firm lines around eyes.

This serum is smoothing, and silky to apply. It deeply hydrates my skin, and keeps it from feeling dry and tight. It smells great, not like some serums. The Perricone products always make me feel like I'm really using quality products on my face.

I wasn't wowed by the product but I don't have major lines around my eyes. It did "tingle" more than I liked. The first few days were a bit of a burn. One drop from the dropper seems like enough or too much for both eyes. There is no unpleasant odor. I don't think I would purchase because I don't think there is not enough bang for your buck. The product is okay.

I like this eyelid lift serum. Thick but same way lightweight texture applies very easily and only a tiny drop is needed, so the bottle will last for a several months. Its a fragrance free formula and perfect for sensitive skin, eyes. The serum absorbs very quickly and leaves skin smooth with out oilyness or stickiness. I don't notice much of lifting effect, probably need to finish all product. Will continue to use.

This is a wonderful product and it works!! It's a light clear consistency, a little goes a long way. Need less than a pea size to cover around both eyes. It feels wonderful and my eyelids feel more youthful, don't even notice the crepeiness as much. My eyelids feel moisturized and tighter. I do feel a slight burning on one eyelid but it may just be my skin? It has also taken away the slight puffiness I thought I had. Overall this is wonderful and I will keep using it. Thank you Perricone MD and influenster for opening my eyes!
This product is great!! It is so easy to apply. Goes on smooth and dries clear. Does not cause dryness. Made my skin feel tighter and lifted. Highly recommend!!

I have to preface this by admitting that I have inherited my mother's slightly droopy eyelids, which can really only be corrected with surgery….but, this product does a decent job at temporarily lifting and firming my eyelids then virtually anything else I've tried! It works about the same when I use it under my eyes as well for firming purposes…but I also use another Perricone MD product for that particular purpose as well (see my review on that in my profile!) This is a very high end product with a high end retail price, so I expected a lot from it and it does deliver, at least as much as a product can considering the effect is only temporary….i like the dropper design and the fact that a little goes a long way…your experience may vary depending on your skin chemistry but if you're looking to solve a droopy lid issue or tired looking eyes, this product could be worth a try!

I tried this eye serum and while I like the consistency and non greasy texture I feel like I did not really notice any changes in my skin after a few weeks of use. Normally I give a product a full 90 days of use before I judge it, but this review was due well before that time frame so here we are. I will continue to use the product and see what happens. I did receive this product free in exchange for my honest review from Influenster.

I received this product for FREE from Influenster for my honest review. I can't tell the difference between before & after honestly. The packaging is really nice & elegant so that's a plus. It does leave your skin feeling soft with no tightness. The texture is very smooth & it's an easy enough formula to use during your nighttime routine, but as far as working I couldn't tell!

I have loved Perricone MD for many years. They have so many research-backed products and they're really thoughtful about their ingredients. Neuropeptides are one of the newest ingredients on the market and I love this formulation. It's a creamy serum that absorbs quickly with no irritation. You can see that it's not the runny, watery type of serum from my photo. I also use Tretinoin at night, which can be drying and make my skin more sensitive. This serum feels soothing and immediately hydrating. It also layers well under sunscreen and makeup. I have only used it for a couple weeks, so I can't speak to an eye lifting effect yet, but it makes my eye area look and feel hydrated and reduces the look of fine lines. I'm excited to keep using it.
This product is good. I can see a slight difference in my eyelids. The packaging is nice and the price is good. It did not leave any weird residue, redness or dryness on my eyes.
Nice consistency, absorbs well. I have been using this for a few weeks now so we will see about the lifting
Already seeing slightly less sagging of upper eyelid. Doesn't seem to hang as low. Smooth and pleasant to put on, making it easy to remember to apply morning and night. Very satisfied thus far!

avis.titre: This is one of the best I have tried so far !
avis.texte: This is a awesome eye lift serum ! I have been using for about 3 weeks and absolutely see a difference in the lines and sagging around the eye ! It goes on so smooth and I like the Doppler for easy applications! It's got a pleasant scent and looking forward to seeing more results as I keep using !

avis.titre: I like it! I found that it hydrates and lifts!
avis.texte: This is a good serum! It absorbs fast. I didn't find that it had much of a scent which is what I prefer. The dropper works perfect for the vial. I would definitely recommend using this product

Very nice eye serum. Haven't been using it long enough to notice any huge differences. No irritation noticed. Glides on my eyes easily. Not sticky in consistency. No scent noticed. I hope to see my eye area improve.

The serum is very thick and concentrated. The dropper actually dispenses more than the amount needed for both eyes. It did not irritate my eyes at all. The scent is very strong and bad smelling. I feel like after two weeks I can see an improvement using the product before bed each night.
I really like this skincare product. It isn't goopy, it doesn't hurt my eyes and it's fine under my makeup. Once it's on it feels cool but it dries quickly without leaving a residue.

avis.titre: Good product - still using for better results
avis.texte: I've been using the Perricone Eye serum for approximately two weeks. The texture was rather light weight, however I felt it went on and dried a tad bit sticky at first. But it wasn't uncomfortable at all. I had zero irritation and there was no scent which I loved.. I haven't noticed much change to my eyes however I will continue to use as I feel it requires more time to see results so I'll stick with it until I finish the product.

This eyelid lift serum is really nice-it feels lightweight and absorbs quickly without and stickiness. My upper lids look a bit more lifted and less tired, and it makes my skin feel firmer over time. Definitely a great little step in my eye routine.

This seems to be effective. A great texture not sticky, greasy or heavy feeling. It leaves my skin feeling moisturized and absorbs quickly and does well under makeup. I recommend and will continue using

I actually love this product. Zero irritation. I never put eye cream on my eyelids because I tend to get puffy eyes due to irritation but not with this product. I love this is targeted for eyelids specifically. I do not feel like my eyes are as crepey when using this photo. Eyes are important for me since that has been my #1 feature all my life so getting old has been humbling. I plan to keep using lift serum to get maximum results. Minimal scent.

This eye serum works great! I love the packaging and has a standard dropper. This is a milk colored liquid with a thin texture. It absorbs very well! I did notice that after wearing this my eyeshadow was applying a lot smoother. Would 10/10 buy again!
This serum tightens and has a nice cooling effect when it's applied. I noticed a different after using it when it comes to the fine lines around my eyes
I loved the effectiveness and the feel it provided! It did not trigger any sensitivity, it gave my eyes a great lift, and the applicator was also very nice! Highly recommend this product!

Serving lifted‑lid energy all day. This neuropeptide serum said "crease where?" and my eyelids took it personally. Lightweight, fast‑absorbing, and absolutely not here to play — just here to snatch, smooth, and wake up my face! Loved this eye serum!

avis.titre: Super lightweight but irritate my skin
avis.texte: Thank Influenster for sending me Perricone MD NeuropePride Eyelids Lift Serum. I appreciate that the bottle and dropper are packaged separately. The scent-free formula is a great feature, and the texture is excellent—it is super lightweight, non-greasy, and absorbs very quickly without feeling heavy on the eyelids. I did notice a slight tightening sensation after absorption, but the product felt weightless on my skin afterward. Unfortunately, I was unable to use the product long enough to determine its effectiveness as an eyelid lift treatment. After the first application, I experienced irritation and a burning sensation, so I had to discontinue use.
This lifting eye serum is great. Packaging keeps it fresh. A little bit goes a long way, and you can feel it tightening up your skin as soon as you apply it.

avis.titre: I will buy this product again
avis.texte: I have tried several products to minimize my hooded eyelids (Lancôme, Este Lauder, etc.) with no real results. THIS product works. I have been using it for 5 months and my eyelids look normal; not hooded. I recommend this product.

I was really impressed with this product. It was easy to apply and there was no smell which I appreciate! It leaves a tingling to the area after application but it's not uncomfortable at all. It definitely enhances my eyes and makes me look for awake. A little bit goes a long way. I can see this lasting for a good while. You only need a small amount per eyelid for results!

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. This eyelid serum applies easily. The recommendation is to use twice daily. A little goes a long ways. It takes very little to apply on the eyelids. It absorbs and drys fairly quickly. I have very sensitive skin and I have not experienced any issues or skin reactions with this product. I do think that since using this product my eyes seem brighter. My eyelids definitely feel so much smoother and softer for sure! I am definitely obsessed with how soft my eyelids feel.
I absolutely love this product for my eyelids. It was a product that I didn't really know I needed but so glad I found. Definitely feels hydrating when I use this as well.

The Perricone MD Neuropeptide Eyelids Lift Serum is an excellent product. This serum is very effective for the entire eye area not only the eye lids, The fine lines & creepy skin around my eyes have definitely improved and have smoothed out. My eyelids are not as droopy, The serum itself is almost gel like but not a thick consistency and once applied I feel a small tingly feeling. I don't notice a scent from this product. The packaging itself it nice - the bottle top has a dropper and it works well and dispenses just enough product for application. I would purchase this serum & would recommend it.
My eyes seem to have a few wrinkles but I feel like this serum smoothed them out. It's so soft and it absorbs very quickly, it smells nice and it doesn't irritate my skin

avis.titre: This works for tightening eyelids, less swelling and high...
avis.texte: Tried Perriocine MD Neuropeptide Eyelift Lift Serum, to be honest I applied on upper lid, sides and my eyebag areas. Love the texture, glides so smoothly, helped with tightness, swelling, firmness, less eyelid limp droop and absorption is so good. It doesn't sit on top of my skin, there is no drying, no skin irritation. There is no scent, no perfumy smell and highly recommend it.

I've been using this antioxidant eyelid serum mostly at night (and occasionally in the mornings), and I can already see a noticeable difference in the appearance of my eyelids. They look smoother, firmer, and more refreshed. After seeing these results, I plan to be more consistent with my morning application too. I recently learned it can also help improve under-eye lines, so I've started applying it there as well and I'm excited to see how much more improvement I get over time. One thing that surprised me — I accidentally got some in my eye and it didn't burn or irritate at all, which says a lot about how gentle the formula is. It is definitely on the pricier side, but honestly, with results like this, I feel it's worth the investment. A little goes a long way, and it actually delivers visible improvement.

I start to notice my eyelid became hooded over the past five years. This serum is a my savior! The droplet applicator make it super easy to uses my eyelid and under eye area feel hydrated and rejuvenated after each use. I usually do a gentle massage to make sure the product is absorbed into my skin. I see improvements after around two weeks of using it!

avis.titre: Thick gel-like consistency & not for very sensitive skin
avis.texte: This product is thick and has the consistency of a gel rather than a typical serum, so the eye dropper doesn't work great and it's a very small bottle to begin with. I have sensitive skin - especially around my eyes - and this burned and caused redness and irritation unfortunately. I received this product complimentary in exchange for an honest review.

This product comes in a dropper form and the product is clear and gel like. It feels tingly cooling effect on the the eyes i guess it is suppose to lift the eyelids. It's too early to tell but i like how it feels. I would recommend this for an eye serum not just on the eyelid but under eye as well.

This wasn't a product I knew I needed! I have hooded eyes, and this really did help tighten the skin and make me look more awake. The texture goes on smooth and absorbs nicely. It was packaged nicely; and it was easy to switch out the cap to the dropper cap.

This is a Holy Grail product for me! I have really struggled with my eyelids and under-eye the last couple years- anyone over 40 knows how quickly your eye area can change. I've been looking for a product that will work on my entire eye area and have tried many- this one starting showing results within a few days and now after 2 weeks, I'm seeing a major improvement on both the fine lines and creases under my eyes and the texture on my lids that nothing else has been able to touch. I'm using it exclusively (along with other products from the Neuropeptide line) and will continue to do so. My skin is normal to dry and just soaking it up as soon as I apply.

avis.titre: Definitely reduced my fine lines, but not my puffiness
avis.texte: I've been applying Perricone MD Neuropeptide Eyelid Lift Serum for two weeks around one eye and not the other. I applied both morning and night. For the first few days, I felt a slight tightening sensation, but afterward, I didn't feel any sensation. There is no fragrance, and the texture is smooth and absorbs well into the skin. After two weeks, I noticed the eye with the serum had fewer fine lines, but the puffiness was still there. I'm thinking this serum will continue to be effective and over time, the puffiness "might" get better? Overall, I'd give this serum a high recommendation!!

I enjoy the cooling feel on my eyelids. It's a gel like consistency and you only need a small amount. Comes with a dropper. It does moisturize really well, but haven't noticed any lifting. I think a regular moisturizer would work just as well. It's made in USA.

I've really enjoyed the Perricone MD Neuropeptide Eyelift Serum — it's lightweight, hydrating, and leaves my eye area looking smoother and more refreshed. A great addition for improving firmness without irritation.
Not seeing any immediate benefits, but it's certainly not irritating and it actually feels nice going on, very cool and calming. Maybe if I give it a few months I might feel differently.

I con confidently say I have never tried an eyelid serum before so I don't have much to judge this against. However I can say, not only did I notice results so did my husband. The product itself is thin and clear and went onto the face/lids without any issue. It wasn't sticky which was something I was worried about. It dried down quickly and felt natural on my eyes within minutes. I didn't notice any smell, which I appreciated as that was a concern on mine. At 40 years old with natural age wrinkles my eye area is always something I'm self conscience about. After using this for around 30 days I was shocked that I actually noticed some small changes. I felt like the fine lines around my sensitive eye area were looking plumper and not as deep. Now…. They didn't go away, it's not a miracle or anything, but it makes me feel better that my skin is healthier and hopefully will keep some new wrinkles from forming too quickly. Overall I would recommend this if you are comfortable putting product on/near your eyelid area.

Love the packaging of this product it feels premium. Love the way it dispenses and it lasts a while. It did not irritate my skin and it helped brighten things up. I received for free in exchange for my honest review! I highly recommend this and even with my eyes being somewhat sensitive this product did not cause any irritation or sensitivity issues for me which is great.

I like the packaging and the serum has a nice cooling effect after i put it on. It goes on smooth at first it's kinda tingly for a few seconds. After 10 days of using it, my eyelids kinda lifted a bit. The serum disappears and absorbs really well into the skin, no scent and great packaging. This is very effective and once it completely dry it doesn't feel like anything is there. It would be nice to have this for your whole face. It would be like Botox in a bottle. Although this product may be a little pricey, it is well worth your money.

I've been using Perricone MD Eyelid Lift Serum for a few weeks now, and I'm happy with how refreshed my eyes look. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky, which is great under makeup. I definitely notice a subtle lift and less sagging on my upper lids — not dramatic, but enough that friends have commented that I look more awake. Fine lines around my eyes seem softer too, and I haven't had any irritation even with sensitive skin. It's not a miracle overnight fix, but for 45+ skin that needs a little lift and a little glow, it seems help me look more awake without trying too hard. Worth it if you care about that lifted look and smoother eyelid area.

This product work magic. I eyelid is starting to droop and this has made it lift up and little. It doesnt sting or irrotate at all. I have normal to combination skin and this product work so well for me.
Ive been using this prduct for more than 2 weeks and I can say its great! I had very fine lines that have been fading thanks to this product. Also its great for sensitive eyes like mine.

This is a very lightweight formula. It absorbed into my skin quickly and didn't leave any oily residue behind. It was gentle on my eyes and I didn't experience any irritation. I didn't notice any scent which is great for a product being used near my eyes. I saw very slight improvement over the last two weeks and hope to see continued improvement with more use.

Perricone Neuropeptide Eyelid Lift Serum provides a nice boost for my eye area. The texture is light, silky and melts in without tugging or feeling heavy. After using it, my lids feel a bit firmer and look a bit lifted. It layers nicely under makeup and doesn't pill. If you're looking for something gentle with a luxe feel to help brighten up tired eyes, this one's a good pick.

Love that this comes in a sealed bottle for freshness, that you insert a dropper into. The product is a lightweight liquid that dries quickly once tapped onto the eyelids. Not sticky or tacky, but my eyes feel more open and awake. This did not disturb my eye makeup, nor did it have a scent or irritate my eyes. I am a fan!

avis.titre: Good for reduce wrinkles around eyes
avis.texte: This Perricone MD Neuropeptide eyelid Lift serum works really good. I've been using it for more than 2 weeks. I feel less wrinkle lines, my eye lids firmer. It absorbs very quickly. The bottle with pumping tool is convenient for using

avis.titre: Eyes look more open and skin around them is less s
avis.texte: I have saggy upper eyelids and after using this for a few weeks I have seen the whole eye area tighten up including my upper eyelids. There has been such an improvement in the lines and saggy skin around my eyes. Very happy with the results. I will continue to use this and I think it will become a staple for me.

I feel the difference when using this under my eyes. You can also see the difference. The consistency is that of moisturizer and you just put it under your eyes and rub in. The serum absorbs quickly and smells great. I do this daily and see the difference.

I received this product free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I've been using this serum both on my eyelids and under my eyes, and I am genuinely impressed with the results. The texture is lightweight, silky and it absorbs without feeling sticky. A little goes a long way. After 2 weeks of consistent use my eyelids look smoother and lifted up, but what really surprised me was how well it worked under my eyes. It noticeably smooths out fine lines and wrinkles, making the under eye look more refreshed and youthful. This feels like a true treatment product rather than just a basic eye serum. The smoothing and forming effects are visible with regular use. I will definitely keep using this serum.

I have been using the Perricone MD Neuropeptide Eyelid Lift Serum for a couple of weeks now and I really like how it feels. It is a thick consistency for a serum but sinks in to the skin nicely without any stickiness. I have noticed a slight tightening and lifting of the skin since using this product. Because I like how it makes my skin feel and I have experienced no irritation, I will continue using this product.
I was happy to try this brand...I was happy to the eye left brand. Wanted to see if it help my bags under my eyes. All u need a small application. This is a clear prduct.
